title: Life on the Mississippi, Part 4.

summary: "Life on the Mississippi, Part 4." by Mark Twain is a memoir published in 1883. This work chronicles Twain's experiences as a young steamboat pilot apprentice on the Mississippi River before the Civil War, then recounts his return journey years later. He captures the art of navigating the ever-changing river, shares tales of his training under experienced pilot Horace Bixby, and observes how railroads and modernization transformed the riverboat era and riverside cities he once knew.
